Grade: PP1
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: FUN GAMES
Topic 13.1: Traditional
Suggested lessons in curriculum: as per KICD

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Traditional, part of FUN GAMES in PP1 PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How did you play the games in pairs, small groups and games?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
